title: Control board fault
fullDescription: Hotpoint ovens display F01 when the main control fails its power-on self-test. Reset by cycling power; if persistent, the board needs replacement.

title: Cavity sensor open
fullDescription: F02 indicates the cavity NTC sensor is open. The oven cannot regulate temperature.

title: Cavity sensor shorted
fullDescription: F03 indicates the cavity NTC reads shorted. Replace the sensor.

title: Door lock fault
fullDescription: F04 indicates the self-clean door lock motor did not move correctly.

title: Convection fan fault
fullDescription: F05 indicates convection fan tachometer below threshold. Bearings or motor cap failed.

title: Cooling fan fault
fullDescription: F06 means the cabinet cooling fan failed. Oven will lock out heat.

title: Touch keypad fault
fullDescription: F07 indicates a touch button reads continuously pressed. Clean and reset.

title: Mains voltage fault
fullDescription: F08 reports input voltage outside the operating window.

title: Communication error
fullDescription: F09 indicates loss of communication between display and main control.

title: Runaway temperature
fullDescription:
F10 means the oven detected runaway temperature above safety setpoint. Often a stuck bake relay or shorted element.

Disconnect power immediately and call service.
